title: Cannot sign in after changing my password
description: I changed my password this morning and now the login page says my credentials are wrong. I am blocked from working.

title: Reset link email is not arriving
description: I pressed Forgot password three times and the reset email never arrives in my inbox, not even in spam.

title: Authenticator app lost with my old phone
description: My phone was replaced and I lost the authenticator app so I cannot pass two-factor verification at login.

title: Locked out of my account
description: I am locked out after entering my password incorrectly. I have a deadline in an hour and cannot log in.

title: Single sign-on redirect loop
description: Our single sign-on sends users back to the sign in screen forever after authenticating with the identity provider.

title: Verification code text message not coming
description: The one time password code never reaches me when I sign in, so I am stuck at the login step.

description: I was charged twice this month for my subscription. Please refund the duplicate payment.

description: Our accounting team says the April invoice does not show our tax registration number. Can you fix it when you get a chance?

description: We cancelled the subscription last week but the payment was still debited this month. We would like a refund.

description: Just curious what the pricing looks like if we add 20 more seats to our plan next quarter.

description: The invoice shows 45 seats but we only have 30 users. We were overcharged and need this corrected urgently before payment is due.

title: Blank white page on the Reports screen
description: The Reports screen shows a blank page and the console prints a 500 error. Our whole team is blocked from reports.

title: Totals differ between chart and download
description: The dashboard total does not match the downloaded CSV total for the same report. Numbers are incorrect somewhere.

title: Save button throws an exception
description: When I press Save on the profile form an exception message appears and nothing is saved. It does not stop me from working otherwise.

title: Typo in the footer text
description: Minor cosmetic issue: the footer says 'Copyrigth' instead of 'Copyright'. No rush at all.

description: After running the monthly import, half of our employee records are gone. This is a serious data loss and it affects all users.

title: Page freezes when filtering by date
description: The attendance page freezes and then crashes whenever I filter by date range. This is broken since yesterday.

title: How do I download the attendance report as Excel
description: Where can I find the option to export the attendance report to an Excel file?

title: How to invite a new manager
description: How can I invite a new manager and make sure they only see their team? Just a question, no rush.

title: How to change the notification email
description: How do I change which email address receives the weekly summary notifications?

title: Steps to set up a recurring report
description: Is it possible to schedule a report to run every Monday? Please share the steps to set it up.

title: Where can I see who edited a record
description: Where can I see the history of who edited an employee record and when? A guide would be great.

title: API says unauthorized with the new key
description: Our application calls the REST API with the new key but every call returns 401 unauthorized and the integration is failing.

title: Scheduled file missing from our SFTP folder
description: The scheduled export file did not arrive on our SFTP server last night and our downstream job failed.

title: Webhook payload missing the employee id
description: The webhook payload we receive for new hires has no employee id field. Our endpoint cannot match the records.

title: Salesforce connector stopped syncing
description: The Salesforce connector stopped sync since Tuesday. Contacts are no longer updating between the systems.

title: Rate limit error from the API
description: We keep hitting the API rate limit when importing data in the morning. Is there a way to raise it? Not urgent.

title: OAuth token refresh endpoint failing
description: The OAuth endpoint refuses to refresh our token and all partner integration calls are blocked right now.

title: Add a dark theme
description: It would be great to have a dark mode in the web app. Nice to have, no rush.

title: Feature request: bulk edit for tickets
description: Please add the ability to select many records and edit them in bulk. This would be a new feature for our team.

title: Support for Hindi language
description: Could you add support for Hindi in the interface? It would be a great enhancement for our field staff.

title: Enhancement: export to PDF
description: We would love an enhancement that lets us export reports straight to PDF as well.

title: Question about the company holiday calendar
description: I was wondering about the holiday calendar for next year and who maintains it.

title: Thanks for the quick help
description: Just wanted to say thank you to the support team for sorting out my earlier request so fast.
